title: lupinus pilosus subsp. tassilicus
intro: Lupinus pilosus subsp. tassilicus, commonly known as the Atlas lupine, is a plant species that belongs to the genus Lupinus, which includes a wide range of lupine plants. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lupinus pilosus subsp. tassilicus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with digestive issues, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as stimulating digestion, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial effects.
